provenance.author: Claude Code agent (Opus 5.5); synthetic open questions written the way a teacher types them into a quiz editor
provenance.label_question: Does grading a student's answer to this question require checking a calculation, algebraic manipulation, expression equivalence or unit conversion?
provenance.arguable_policy: Arguable prompts are run and listed but excluded from precision and recall.
provenance.reuse: New prompts; none copied from typesafe_route_cases.json
provenance.review: Re-reviewed once by the same agent before inference, including the arithmetic in every computational scheme; no label changed
